description: Header file for ContinueWatching plugin implementation in WPEFramework, defining classes and interfaces for managing continue watching tokens, including support for Netflix-specific implementation.

classes.name: ContinueWatching
classes.description: Main plugin class handling JSONRPC communication for continue watching tokens, with methods to get, set, and delete tokens.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingImpl
classes.description: Abstract base class defining interface for continue watching token management, including encryption/decryption and JSON file operations.

classes.name: NetflixContinueWatchingImpl
classes.description: Netflix-specific implementation of ContinueWatchingImpl, managing tokens for Netflix application.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingImplFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of ContinueWatchingImpl based on application name.

methods.name: encryptData
methods.description: Encrypts clear data into protected data buffer.

methods.name: decryptData
methods.description: Decrypts protected data into clear data buffer.

methods.name: sha256
methods.description: Computes SHA256 hash of a string.

methods.name: writeToJson
methods.description: Writes protected data to JSON file.
